entities.name: Andrew Donald Booth
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrew Donald Booth was a British electrical engineer, physicist and computer scientist who was an early developer of the magnetic drum memory for computers. He is known for Booth's multiplication algorithm. In his later career in Canada he became president of Lakehead University.
